primary_source_title: Bracteal Exudates in Two Cirsium Species as Possible Deterrents to Insect Consumers of Seeds
claim_boundary: Seed predation was significantly greater when sticky bracteal exudates were occluded in central Illinois in 1980; one species/site/year benefit context, not a universal effect.

primary_source_title: Bracteal Exudates in Two Cirsium Species as Possible Deterrents to Insect Consumers of Seeds
claim_boundary: No treatment effect was evident in northwestern Minnesota in 1980 or 1982; directly demonstrates within-genus context dependence.

primary_source_title: Arthropods Utilizing Sticky Inflorescences of Cirsium Discolor and Penstemon Digitalis
claim_boundary: Pollinators did not contact traps; several seed predators avoided them; ants and aphids were deterred; some predatory arthropods appeared to glean from sticky traps. Guild selectivity is mechanism context, not a fitness effect.
